step-1.text: Lay out every part and count them, because cribs must be complete. Stand one end frame up and bolt the back side frame to it, two bolts.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 end frame, 1 side frame and 2 bolts.

step-2.text: Choose the base height. Use the high position, about 37 centimeters, for a newborn, and the low one as soon as your baby can sit up. Screw the base to the end frame.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 mattress base and 4 screws.

step-3.text: Bolt the front side frame to the same end frame. Bars facing in, smooth side out.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 side frame and 2 bolts.

step-4.text: Close the box with the second end frame. Four bolts, then screw the base to this end too.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 end frame, 4 bolts and 4 screws.

step-5.text: Tighten every bolt, then push hard on each corner. Nothing should wobble or gap. Check the bolts again every few months.

count-5.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: The crib is built. Do one more round of bolt checks, then make it cozy. Congratulations.
